Package com.netgrif.application.engine.petrinet.domain.repositories

Interface PetriNetRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<PetriNet,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<PetriNet,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<PetriNet,String>, org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<PetriNet,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<PetriNet,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<PetriNet>, org.springframework.data.querydsl.QuerydslPredicateExecutor<PetriNet>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<PetriNet,String>
public interface PetriNetRepository extends org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository<PetriNet,String>, org.springframework.data.querydsl.QuerydslPredicateExecutor<PetriNet>
Repository interface for handling operations on PetriNet entities. Extends MongoRepository for standard CRUD operations and QuerydslPredicateExecutor to support dynamic queries.
